Aron , Shinx , and Grubbin —who live at the Old Gold Power Plant—will also appear on Greengrass Isle during this two-week-long event! On top of that, you can get great rewards—like Aron Incense , Shinx Incense , and Grubbin Incense —by completing limited-time missions during the event. Note: After 2024/10/31 , you’ll no longer be able to use Aron Incense , Shinx Incense , or Grubbin Incense on Greengrass Isle. We hope you’re looking forward to this event! Event Periods: • Week 1: Monday, October 7, at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, October 14, at 3:59 a.m. • Week 2: Monday, October 14, at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, October 21, at 3:59 a.m. Event Areas: • Greengrass Isle and the Old Gold Power Plant Mission Periods: • Week 1: Monday, October 7, at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, October 21, at 3:59 a.m. • Week 2: Monday, October 14, at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, October 21, at 3:59 a.m. Bonuses The following effects will trigger in the applicable areas during the event. — All Days (10/7 to 10/20) — • Certain Pokémon will be more likely to appear during sleep research. • A few Pokémon of different sleep types will appear during sleep research regardless of your sleep type for that day. Pokémon You Can Encounter in Each Area The following Pokémon are more likely to appear! Slightly Greater Appearance Rate Aron, Shinx, Grubbin, and Drifloon. To Researchers Who Have Unlocked the Old Gold Power Plant If you want to encounter Aron, Shinx, Grubbin, or Drifloon, we recommend that you research at the Old Gold Power Plant . You are more likely to encounter these Pokémon there than on Greengrass Isle during the event period. Notes • [Important] Each day of the Old Gold Power Plant event rolls over at 4:00 a.m. • If you track your sleep in areas other than Greengrass Isle or the Old Gold Power Plant during the event, you won’t meet Aron, Shinx, or Grubbin. • After the event, Aron, Shinx, and Grubbin will no longer appear during sleep research conducted on Greengrass Isle (except when using that Pokémon’s incense). • After 2024/10/31 , you’ll no longer be able to use Aron Incense, Shinx Incense, or Grubbin Incense on Greengrass Isle. • Event bonuses apply only to sleep data tracked during the event. • If you wait to report sleep data tracked before the event began and select “Review Later” during the event, event bonuses will not be applied. • If you wait to report sleep data tracked during the event and select “Review Later” after the event has ended, event bonuses will be applied. • Event bonuses do not apply to sleep tracking during the tutorial.
